items.title: Under-pan value structure: the zone below every pan front reads as stacked mid-grey shelves; in every photo it is a near-black cavity
items.evidence: q15 side blocks, under-pan boxes (render 800-880 x 442-478 / 60-140 x 440-480; photo 780-870 x 420-458 / 60-150 x 420-460): median L 32 / 50 vs photo 23 / 19, so the render's mid-tones are 1.4-2.6x too light. The crops (cmp_L / cmp_R) show a lit grey tray lip, a stiffener and a silver front cross tube as three horizontal light bars under each pan; y_47300 shows only black under the pans, with the floor-level arm and leg tubes catching light. e10_under: a continuous light bar (tray #7d8187, stiffener #5d6168, front tube SEATMAT.frame #a3a8ae metallic) spans the block just under the pans. y_47302 (zoomed) and sans 13 / 23: the fabric pan front drops straight into a dark cavity (black SEB boxes, dark mechanism); the only light objects are the small electronics box, the arm paddles and the baggage bar near the floor. Nothing grey shows directly under the cushion.
items.expectedGain: +0.3 on 'Seat pan / front' and +0.3 on 'Legs / under-seat' (A); the largest tone-structure error left at q15 and q17

items.title: Pan waterfall and plan: tighter front roll over a taller vertical fabric face, narrower side roll, wider pans so the joints close
items.evidence: cushionSecs(0.455, 0.47, 0.095, -0.05, {edge 0.05, r 0.05}) applies the same 5 cm quarter-round to the front and both sides. The flat top is therefore only 0.355 wide, and between neighbours the rolls open a V about 0.10 + 0.028 m wide at crown height. That V is the 4-6 px dark outer joints (w32b-5) and the 16 px band the seam filler tried to hide (w32a-1). The front face has only ~2 cm of straight wall before the 5 cm roll, so e11 reads as a puffy pillow on a shelf. y_47302 (zoomed, middle and right seats): the front roll radius is ~2.5-3 cm over a near-vertical fabric face ~6-7 cm tall, the bottom tucks back, and the corners are nearly square in plan. sans 13 / 14: neighbouring pans abut with a 1-3 px seam under the arm. y_47303: the front edge stands slightly proud of the mid-pan, with a waterfall rather than a dome.
items.expectedGain: +0.3 on 'Seat pan / front' (closes the joint issue without a filler and fixes the profile); +0.1 on the q15 hero row
items.fix: econSeat, replace lines 72-75: `const ps = cushionSecs(0.47, 0.47, 0.10, -0.055, { edge: 0.032, r: 0.03, crown: 0.008 }); for (const s of ps.slice(2)) s.w = 0.47 - (0.47 - s.w) * 0.4;` (side roll ~1.3 cm, front roll 3.2 cm, plan corners r ~0.03-0.045). Then `ps[0] = { ...ps[0], w: 0.455, d: 0.43, z: 0.015 }; ps[1] = { ...ps[1], y: ps[0].y + 0.04 }; ps.splice(1, 0, { ...ps[1], y: ps[0].y + 0.012, w: 0.468, d: 0.455, z: 0.006 });` for a 4 cm vertical front wall and a 3 cm bottom tuck. Pan mount pitch `3 * DEG` -> `5 * DEG` (front edge +0.8 cm: the waterfall stands proud). The pan edge sits 6 mm from each arm centre, so the 0.022 grey plate covers the slot from above; ECON_SEAM stays deleted. Re-check the belt boxes at y 0.474-0.478 (pan crown is now ~0.468 at mid-pan) and the pillow foot. Same triangle count, and the far LOD pan follows (item 5).

items.title: Legs: slim round silver tubes on a floor rail, not chunky rectangular boxes on grey blocks
items.evidence: y_47303 zoom (p03_legs vs r17_legs): each leg is a ~2.5 cm round polished tube rising diagonally from a horizontal floor tube; the floor tube and a small U stirrup carry the highlight, and the rest is dark. q17 render: rectangular boxes (0.035 x 0.31 x 0.045 vertical, 0.035 x 0.34 x 0.045 raked at -22 deg), two 0.05 x 0.025 x 0.12 grey track blocks and a 0.04 x 0.05 x 0.46 beam box read as bulky grey castings with flat lit faces. e8 shows the same blocky foot. y_47304 confirms a polished seat track with dark fittings: the only big grey casting is the footrest bracket, behind the hangers.

items.title: Under-seat parts at the right height and material: smoky translucent life-vest pouch near the baggage bar, electronics box tucked under the pan front
items.evidence: y_47302 zoom: the pouch is a smoky, translucent oval dome about 0.20 x 0.13 m. It sits low, just above and behind the baggage bar (y ~0.12-0.19), with a darker folded-vest core, a light rim highlight, and a red pull strap (~2.5 x 8 cm) with a small blue/white tag hanging from its front edge. Render (e10 / e11): an opaque dark saucer #2b2e33, r 0.085, at y 0.215 right under the pan, so it reads as a puck stuck to the pan. Electronics box: in the photo it is light grey (~#c8cacc), ~0.08 wide x 0.09 tall, its top tight under the pan front next to the arm leg, with a dark display window in the upper half and a blue LED. Render: a pure-white 0.07 box centred at y 0.26, its top 7 cm below the pan bottom, with a black lower face, so it floats.

items.title: Far LOD: dark under-seat block, lower arm plate, squarer pan, a box pillow and cover height in step with the near LOD
items.evidence: econUnitFar has nothing below the pans, so at q16 far rows the light carpet and blue aisle strip show straight through under every far seat. y_47301 far rows are dark below the pan line. The pan is gRBox(0.455, 0.10, 0.47, r 0.05): a soft pillow with the same 10 cm V-joints as item 2, and joints that open wider with mip blur. Arms are floating 0.048 x 0.05 x 0.30 boxes with no C plate, so the aisle-side white C rhythm along the aisle in y_47301 (one white C per row) is missing. No pillow, while y_47300 / 47301 show navy pillows on rows 2-6. The cover gBox is 0.215 tall, the same as the over-tall near cover (question 21). Fabric snow at distance is lighting-owned (w32a-L2) and is not counted here.

notes: Order is by visual impact. Item 1 is value and tone structure, visible in q15, q16 and q17 and every close-up. Item 2 is silhouette, proportion and the joints. Item 3 is silhouette at q17. Item 4 covers missing or misplaced parts in close-ups. Item 5 is far rows. Items 1 and 2 are colour and parameter changes with no triangle cost. Items 3 and 4 add about +0.4k tris per 3-seat unit, about 1.5 % of econ3's 28,955. Far LOD adds about 36 tris per seat, all boxes. Do items 1+2 as one candidate: the dark cavity makes a tighter pan front read, and the wider pans with a narrow side roll remove the joint V. Re-rate the joints with the w32 scripts (dark runs at q15 y 555-565, target <= 3 px). Do not re-add any filler. The headrest cover height (question 21, both raters, every round) is still the largest econ-owned mismatch outside this brief's scope.
